fields.PRODUCT NAME: Peacock Glory – Rajasthani Handcrafted Marble Table Clock
fields.DESCRIPTION: Add a royal touch to your décor with this stunning Peacock Glory – Rajasthani Handcrafted Marble Table Clock. Beautifully carved from marble and adorned with intricate hand-painted peacocks, this piece is further enhanced with traditional Kundan stonework and vibrant enamel detailing, reflecting the rich artistic heritage of Rajasthan.
